name: DynamicVLA Table 1 tracking adaptation v1

dimensions.CR: Lateral direction reversals (one cycle per 4 seconds).
dimensions.LS: Continuous 30-second tracking with repeated three-axis motion.
dimensions.VU: Exposure/contrast variation and a fixed peripheral visual occluder.
dimensions.SR: Tracking at ten different workspace/depth locations.
dimensions.MP: RGB freezes of 0.24 seconds at t=2 and t=5; state and velocity remain current.
dimensions.VG: Five apple meshes absent from the single-apple training data; same room.
dimensions.DR: Two scripted 2.5 cm target displacements over 0.2 seconds (kinematic push proxy).

success_definition: Complete the full horizon and keep 3D EE-to-hover-target distance <=0.02 m for at least 25% of the entire episode, including the initial second. Intervals need not be consecutive. Orientation is not a success gate.
time_definition: Time to accumulate at least 25% of the requested episode duration within 2 cm. Failed/terminated trials receive their full requested horizon; successful-only time is also reported. Simulation time, excluding expert warmup and inference pauses.
scope: Ten seeded workspace setups in ONE training room, not ten distinct DOM scenes. VG tests five held-out apple geometries, not held-out scene generalization. LS is continuous long-horizon tracking, not manipulation sequencing. VU/MP/DR are declared tracking proxies.
inputs: Two RGB views, fixed tracking instruction, measured robot EE pose; current simulator object velocity for velocity-conditioned models and analytic residual drift. No target pose/future trajectory sent to the neural policy.
timing: 25 Hz RGB, 200 Hz physics/scoring; fixed 0.8 s replanning, world paused during inference. Same adapter, controller and expert warmup as previous comparison.
recording: All trials retain telemetry/action chunks/initial states; three-view videos for trial 0 of each setup (360 recorded trials). Pilot videos for every pilot trial.
previous_success_definition: Full horizon; 3D EE-to-hover-target distance <=0.02 m at every 200 Hz sample from t=1.0 s through the final state. Orientation is not a success gate.
previous_time_definition: Sustained acquisition time (earliest time after the last tolerance violation); failures receive the requested horizon. Successful-only time is also reported; this is not DOM manipulation completion time.
scoring_change_reason: User requested 25% of the full episode within 2 cm; no new physics or policy inference is required for rescoring.
